subject: DPA and SCCs: retention carveout & HIPAA scope for Helios pilot
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@helios-ai.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Alvarez <mark.alvarez@helios-ai.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA + SCCs: retention clause and HIPAA scope for pilot

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited about the pilot. Legal reviewed the draft DPA and had a few asks before we can proceed to procurement:

- Retention: they want a 3 year retention carveout for logs and model telemetry; can you confirm Redwood's default retention and whether exceptions are negotiable for enterprise customers?
- SCCs: Helios is EU-based; we need confirmation you will execute the EU Commission standard contractual clauses. Any plan to include a signed SCC template?
- HIPAA/APIs: part of the pilot will ingest minimally necessary PHI for a subset of customers. Is Redwood willing to scope the pilot under a BAA or, alternatively, confirm that processing will be limited to de-identified data only?
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II report and a completed SIG Lite would speed up our security review — can you provide the latest artifacts and an owner for SOC 2 questions?

I attached Helios_DPA_comments.docx with inline comments. Can we get a redline back by end of week? Procurement wants a playbook for signature routing (legal -> procurement -> finance) and any escalation steps if we need exec sign-off.

Thanks,
Sarah Jenkins
Senior Counsel, Helios AI

Attachment: Helios_DPA_comments.docx (docx)
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs: retention clause and HIPAA scope for pilot

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear checklist and the comments doc. Looping in Priyom (Legal) and Neha (Privacy) to handle redlines and the SOC 2/SIG requests. Quick answers from my side:

- Retention: Redwood's default telemetry retention is 12 months; we can discuss a limited enterprise exception but would need to align on scope and retention justification.
- SCCs: we can execute the EU Commission SCCs; Legal will attach the signed template we use for EU transfers.
- HIPAA: we do support HIPAA-covered workloads via a BAA, but it requires additional controls and an onboarding checklist; if you intend to process PHI during pilot we should treat it as a scoped BAA engagement.
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II and a recent SIG Lite are available. Priyom, can you produce a redline and a short evidence pack (SOC 2, SIG, CAIQ pointers) for Sarah?

Proposed next steps (timeline):
1) Priyom to circulate Redwood redline (v1) and call out any non-standard concessions — target: Wed EOD.
2) Neha to share SOC 2 & SIG contacts + quick note on DPIA/HIPAA scope — target: Thu AM.
3) If Helios accepts redline, we'll route to DocuSign with signer matrix: Redwood Legal -> Helios Legal -> Helios Procurement -> Redwood Finance (final) — Priyom/Neha, confirm if Exec sign-off might be required for retention >12 months.

I'll hold a short sync if needed once redlines land.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 May 2028 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood redline + evidence pack (SOC 2 / SCCs / HIPAA notes)

Sarah / team — attached is Redwood's consolidated redline (redline_for_helios.docx) and a short evidence checklist. Highlights of our position:

- Retention: Redwood standard = 12 months for telemetry (account/usage logs); for commercial agreements we will consider a documented exception to 24 months with explicit legal justification and compensating controls (encryption at rest, access logging for retention buckets, stricter retention-access approvals). We cannot agree to open-ended 3-year log retention without Exec approval.

- SCCs: We accept execution of the EU Commission standard contractual clauses. We'll insert the SCC schedule as an execution exhibit; signature of SCCs is handled at contract signature time (DocuSign supports stacking).

- HIPAA: For pilot processing involving PHI, we require a BAA. Alternative: if Helios can commit to pseudonymized / de-identified inputs for the pilot, we can proceed under the standard DPA but will need a DPIA addendum documenting risk and processing boundaries.

- Evidence: Attached links and owners — SOC 2 Type II report (security@redwood.com), SIG Lite (security@redwood.com), CAIQ mapping (compliance@redwood.com). We can provide redacted reports under NDA.

Open items we need from Helios: exact retention categories you want covered by the 3-year ask (logs vs model telemetry vs customer data), confirmation if any PHI will be present in pilot, and your procurement signature path (who signs last).

If retention >12 months is required, I will escalate to Finance/Legal execs; please note that may affect commercial terms.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

2) Evidence pack: Neha will send SOC 2 and SIG delivery instructions by Thu AM.

3) Signature routing: once Helios confirms the redline, we'll generate a DocuSign envelope pre-populated with the SCC exhibit and our BAA checkbox (if PHI is in scope).
